inputs.text: Exactly—the “legal reform” label is cover for concentrating surveillance control while stripping away the judges who could hold anyone accountable. A closed-door discussion followed by a House vote expected Thursday looks less like deliberation than a managed handoff, with the public kept out until the outcome is set. The lawyers’ warnings aren’t a side issue; they’re the part being pushed aside because oversight would get in the way. The secrecy tells you who this arrangement is meant to protect.
